subject: statstics: trigger evict by the timer (#58027)
summary: Wires a new `TriggerEvict()` method through the stats cache interfaces and calls it periodically from the domain memory-stats ticker to prompt LFU cache eviction when over capacity. Reviewed LFU `triggerEvict` behavior and Domain shutdown ordering; no Blocker/High correctness, consistency, concurrency, or SQL-semantics issues found, and upstream/master retains the same approach (no later fix indicating a severe bug).
